summary: RETEST of iteration_72 fixes. All 8 requested items verified working. Backend: new anti-forgery suite 9/9 passed on the public URL. It rejects (status failed, score null): tap_ms missing with duration 100ms, tap_ms shorter than taps, duration about 4s below server play time, one tap gap of 20ms, average 120ms per tap, and duration longer than server time. Genuine runs are accepted with score equal to the last tap stamp (4430ms; 6000ms with 1s extra latency). demo_start returns [200,200,200,409]. The iteration_72 e2e API suite is 14/14 after I updated its realistic_run helper to 225ms per tap: the old 75ms per tap is now correctly rejected. Frontend at 390px mobile: sc-timer shows ms (29.683s -> 29.583s, all samples distinct, regex \d+\.\d{3}s). Expiry at 0 gives TIME EXPIRED with -- time and no share card; remaining drops to 2. Demo -> real attempt 1 completed at 5.356s with per-attempt share. WhatsApp opens api.whatsapp.com/send?text=%F0%9F%8F%86... (emojis encoded correctly). Refresh mid-attempt drops remaining from 2 to 1. The leave dialog text is correct and Continue keeps the intro. Leave shows PARTIAL RESULTS, and its X now closes directly with no dialog and no toast; after a reload the challenge does not reappear. The final scorecard's 9 buttons are all one column (x=16, w=358). Intl user: after intl-tour-skip the challenge appears on /choose-world with no navigation; remaining shows 'Practice only', the block reason is shown and Start Real is disabled. Admin at 1920px: SC-QA-WELCOME (published) is selected by default with the Pause button; the Participants ATTEMPTS column shows 1/3, 1/3, 0/3. New cosmetic issues: in the story/square PNG an 'Attempt 2' row with a non-time status renders as 'Attempt 2ABANDONED' (the label and status overlap). The story PNG still has a large empty band between 'Think you can beat my time?' and the URL.

minor.issue: Lower-bound tolerance is MAX_LATENCY_MS=2000. A genuine player's client duration is shorter than server play time by the start response latency + submit latency + countdown setTimeout drift + client submit retries (realDone retries 3x with 800ms waits on network error). On a slow mobile network, a backgrounded tab during the countdown, or a submit retry, a genuine finish can be marked 'failed' (timing_mismatch) and the attempt lost. Consider measuring countdown start client-side vs. server (e.g. an /attempts/{id}/go ping when the countdown ends), or log close_reason=timing_mismatch rates for review.

ui_bugs.issue: The label 'Attempt N' is drawn left at w*0.2 and the status is drawn right-aligned at w*0.8 in a large font. Long statuses (ABANDONED/EXPIRED/FORFEITED) collide, so the row renders 'Attempt 2ABANDONED'. Shrink the font for non-time labels, widen the row, or use title-case ('Abandoned').

issues: A large empty vertical gap remains between 'Think you can beat my time?' and the URL (about 25% of the card). It is better than before but still not filled.
The WhatsApp/Instagram icons in the 3-column row look like tiny dots (the icon shrinks); add shrink-0 to the icon.

critical_code_review_comments: _score: the checks are correct and in a good order. tap_ms is now required (len == taps); there is a 40ms min gap, a 150ms average, and the last stamp must be within 250ms of duration.

ChallengeGame realDone retry loop: each network retry adds 800ms+ before the server receives the submit. Two retries can push a genuine run past MAX_LATENCY_MS and it is then rejected as timing_mismatch.
SignupChallengeGate listens to pl-intl-tour-done, which IntlWelcomeTour dispatches. Correct.
